text.en: Clients consistently praise groomer Shelly and her salon team for their warmth and dedication. Pet parents emphasize that they followed Shelly to this location because of her reliable work ethic, describing the crew as courteous and a pleasure to work with during appointments.

Dog owners emphasize that pets receive attentive and compassionate care throughout their visits. Reviewers note that staff members treat visiting dogs with genuine affection, helping pets feel at ease in a welcoming atmosphere that feels just like home.

Reviewers appreciate the straightforward scheduling and punctual service provided by the salon. Clients mention that the team stays on schedule, greets visitors warmly, and makes collaborating on their pet grooming needs effortless from start to finish.

q.en: Does the facility offer boarding in addition to grooming?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention utilizing the facility for dog boarding as well as routine haircuts and baths.

q.en: Are appointments typically kept on time?

a.en: Clients consistently note that the team adheres to scheduled appointment times without unnecessary delays.

q.en: How do dogs respond to the salon environment?

a.en: Owners describe a cozy, home-like environment where pets receive gentle affection and feel comfortable.
